subject: Closure criteria, fallback lanes, and trigger plan
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@mavenpay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Close timeline — stabilization window and acceptance gating

Laura — thanks for the call earlier. We ran the internal readiness check and there are a couple of items that will push the acceptance window out unless we land concrete mitigations:

- Prod infra teams want a one-week stabilization window after canary (they're asking for 7 business days).
- Procurement has a legal hold on payment terms until they see the final SOC evidence (procureco is coordinating).
- Our QA needs an additional regression pass for the integration tests (estimated 3 days).

Given that, legal is going to ask us to move the close date if we can’t show a defensible fallback. Can Redwood propose a plan that preserves our ability to commit to a December close but with clear pass/fail triggers?

Attaching the checklist from our readiness review (high level).

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Director, Integrations — MavenPay
attachments: readiness-checklist.pdf (summary)
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@mavenpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 18:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Closure criteria, fallback lanes, and trigger plan

Daniel — appreciate the clear summary. We can lock in a conditional-close approach so your procurement/legal and infra teams have deterministic gates. Proposed high level (attached: MAP-v2.xlsx):

1) Canary + 3-business-day accelerated stabilization: start canary on Dec 10, monitor P95 token latency, error rate, and KV-hit ratio.
2) Acceptance triggers (all must pass):
   - P95 latency < 120ms at 95% load test window
   - No regression > 0.5% in acceptance-quality evals on the demo prompt set
   - SOC evidence delivery (procureco acknowledgment) or Escrow hold agreement in place
3) Fallback lanes: if INFRA requests full 7-day window, we commit to a staged acceptance: close on Dec 21 for non-critical endpoints, staggered cutover for high-throughput routes Jan 4.
4) Escalation: if any trigger fails, Redwood will commit to a one-time credit and a prioritized remediation canary within 48 hours.

I attached MAP-v2 with dates and responsibilities. Can Marcus confirm the cost/credit cadence and Connor confirm procurement handoff steps?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP-v2.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@mavenpay.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Dec 2028 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Closure criteria, fallback lanes, and trigger plan

Laura / Daniel — I reviewed the MAP-v2 and sketched a lightweight risk log to quantify potential exposure (attached map-risk-log.csv). Quick notes:

- Likelihood/impact: infra stabilization (medium/medium) ⇒ ~0.8% revenue carryover risk assuming a 2-week delay.
- Legal hold on SOC docs (low/medium) ⇒ can be mitigated with an escrow clause; cost of escrow/legal facilitation ~ $12k one-time.
- QA regression (medium/low) ⇒ mitigate via parallel regression run we can run during canary and return results in 3 days.

Credit/financial fallback: proposing a 2% one-time credit if rolling close is required OR a staged billing start (bill only non-critical routes until Jan 4). Marcus — can you confirm finance signoff?

Marcus Lin
VP, Commercial — Redwood Inference
attachments: map-risk-log.csv
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@mavenpay.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Dec 2028 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Procurement & escrow next steps

Forwarding procurement thread with ProcureCo to get legal aligned. Summary of actions I requested from ProcureCo (Elena):

- Confirm timeline to deliver SOC evidence (target Dec 8) or provide Escrow acceptance letter by Dec 9.
- If Escrow letter accepted, legal will allow conditional close with staged billing as Marcus suggested.
- ProcureCo to return signed escrow clause ready to append to redline (Connor to coordinate final placement).

Attachment: contract-redline.pdf (redline with proposed escrow clause).

On our side Ive flagged the engineering playbook for accelerated remediation (48h canary patch rotation) so we can promise a prioritized follow-up if any trigger trips.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Sr. Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@mavenpay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Dec 2028 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Closure criteria, fallback lanes, and trigger plan

Laura — this is helpful and addresses a lot of our concerns. Quick confirmation from our side:

- Procurement (Elena) will try to deliver SOC confirmation by Dec 8; if not available, they will provide an escrow acceptance letter by Dec 9.
- Engineering agrees to the accelerated stability windows if Redwood guarantees the 48h remediation commitment.

We are OK to proceed with the conditional-close approach. Updated preferred close date: Dec 21 for initial close with staged rollout; final completion Jan 4. Please update the MAP and share the DocuSign when ready.

Thanks,
Daniel
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@mavenpay.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Dec 2028 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Final: MAP updated, DocuSign, and handoff cadence

Team — closing the loop. Actions completed:

- MAP-v2.xlsx updated with Dec 10 canary start, Dec 21 initial close (non-critical routes), Jan 4 final completion for high-throughput routes.
- map-risk-log.csv attached to the MAP workbook; credit fallback and staged billing options spelled out.
- contract-redline.pdf uploaded to drive and sent to ProcureCo for signature.
- DocuSign envelope created: https://app.docusign.com/signon/12345-closure-trigger

Next steps:
- Daniel/Procurement: watch for DocuSign and confirm Escrow acceptance letter if SOC isn't available by Dec 9.
- Marcus/Finance: confirm the 2% credit mechanism and staging billing preference by Dec 14.
- Connor/Eng: run the parallel regression during canary and send results by Dec 14.

If all goes to plan we will treat Dec 21 as conditional close and Jan 4 as final. Ill schedule a 15-min check-in on Dec 15 for last-mile status.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
